summary.text: Joe Bustos is a Republican business owner and retired Army lieutenant colonel who has represented District 112 in the South Carolina House of Representatives since November 9, 2020, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Joe Bustos was born in Charleston, South Carolina.

Bustos served in the U.S. Army from 1970 to 1995 and reached the rank of lieutenant colonel, and he earned a B.A. from Columbia College in 1975 and a master's degree from Central Michigan University in 1991.
His career experience includes work as a police officer and as a business owner.
Bustos succeeded Mike Sottile as the District 112 representative.
For 2025-2026 he is assigned to the Medical, Military, Public and Municipal Affairs Committee and the House Rules Committee.
